prompt_en: A photorealistic editorial photograph of one adult woman waiting at the pickup counter of a neighborhood cafe in warm early evening. Her visible facial features and long, softly waved dark hair are informed by the supplied portrait. She wears a charcoal knit sweater with sleeves rolled at the wrists. In the same frame, a customer waits facing the cafe pickup point: standing one step back from its customer-side ledge, she holds a phone at chest height in her right hand, its screen showing a simple order number, and glances toward the arriving cup. A barista behind the counter extends one forearm from the service side and sets a white paper cup with a flat lid on the ledge beside a small wooden sign marked PICKUP. At this exact instant, a prepared drink remains on the service side of the counter, supported by the barista's fingertips. Across the exposed counter surface, an open handoff gap connects the service side and customer side; the prepared drink remains separate from the customer's hands as her left hand rests by her hip and her right hand holds the phone. The cup, sign, and woman form a visible diagonal across the two counter zones, while a wall-mounted menu board and the working counter locate the scene inside the cafe. Warm window light catches the cup rim, her face, and the phone while retaining detail behind the ledge. A standing eye-level three-quarter view includes her face, the phone, both sides of the pickup ledge, the barista forearm, and the complete cup in one frame. Natural skin texture, credible hand geometry, and the quiet rhythm of a routine order pickup make the moment feel observed.
